title: Yasunari Kawabata's birth chart
metaDescription: Yasunari Kawabata's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.9° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — the Sun, Mercury, Neptune and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 19.9° Gemini — the second decan, 10°–20°, which the tradition sub-rules by Venus. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Gemini and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 15.4° Gemini; Venus stands at 24.0° Taurus; Mars stands at 27.2° Leo. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste for the substantial and the lasting from Venus, drive that ignites on contact from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mercury and Pluto: 0.1° from an exact conjunction. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, the Sun opposition Saturn at 0.5°, and Mars sextile Neptune at 2.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Three planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Moon in Cancer at 22.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Gemini at 15.4° is in domicile; Venus in Taurus at 24.0° is in domicile. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 air, 3 fire, 2 water, 1 earth by element and 6 mutable, 3 fixed, 1 cardinal by mode. An air-weighted chart thinks in through-lines; the sentence is how it takes hold of the world. Jupiter, Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.0° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 22.0°.
